'''Jander Bibbbi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who worked for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], serving as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Jackpot'']]. Whilst on an assignment in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], the ''Jackpot'' encountered a number of [[Oblee|shadow lurkers]]&mdash;the incoporeal spirits of the Oblee [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;which attempted to communicate with the crew of the ''Jackpot''. However, their attempts were unsuccessful and instead caused the crew members to disappear. Bibbbi noticed that the creatures were repulsed by [[Fusion lantern/Legends|fusion lanterns]], so he gathered a number of the lanterns and locked himself inside a concealed hold.
